notes: Community GGUF of official LCO-Embedding/LCO-Embedding-Omni-7B rev 108f6f1 (same author as the 3B; verified 2026-07-08). Q8_0 8.1GB + mmproj F16 2.5GB (mmproj REQUIRED for audio). llama.cpp: --embedding --pooling last (mandatory; dim 3584). Converted via heiervang-technologies/ht-llama.cpp (Qwen2.5-Omni-thinker + audio mmproj support). Cannot co-reside with the resident 30B llama-server — sequential GPU use. REPLACES the official safetensors 7B in this manifest (owner 2026-07-08: llama.cpp-first; safetensors form dropped as redundant — fetch from LCO-Embedding/LCO-Embedding-Omni-7B if a SentenceTransformer-exact reference is ever needed).

name: e5-omni-7b
notes: SentenceTransformer / Qwen2.5-Omni-7B thinker. EXCLUDE assets/. Xet-backed shards — single-connection fetch mandatory. Won't co-reside with llama-server on 24GB. NO GGUF exists anywhere (verified 2026-07-08); self-conversion feasible via ht-llama.cpp (same arch, LoRA pre-merged, last-token pooling -> --pooling last) BUT modal_temp.pt per-modality temperature is NOT representable in GGUF — cross-modal score calibration must be re-applied in scoring code. Defer unless head-to-head justifies.
